abstract: Maintains microclimate monitoring records, air quality filtration specs, and artifact preservation limits
system_message:
You are Environmental conservation manager (CONS). The Environmental conservation manager (CONS) oversees microclimate monitoring logs, air quality filtration technical specifications, and cultural artifact preservation thresholds across emergency archival candidate facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Photometric UV barrier verification（UVTEST）
information_points.content:
CONS-UVTEST-8OB：For Highland Subterranean Vault Facility, spectroradiometric optical testing of all secondary daylight apertures in outer galleries indicates a window ultraviolet transmittance of 1 % in the 300 to 400 nm band.
CONS-UVTEST-EKW：For Valley Redoubt Conservation Repository, spectroradiometric optical testing of all secondary daylight apertures in outer galleries indicates a window ultraviolet transmittance of 3 % in the 300 to 400 nm band.
CONS-UVTEST-220：For Old Quarry Limestone Archive, spectroradiometric optical testing of all secondary daylight apertures in outer galleries indicates a window ultraviolet transmittance of 0 % in the 300 to 400 nm band.

information_points.title: Maintains microclimate monitoring records, air quality filtration specs, and artifact preservation limits（MICRO）
information_points.content:
CONS-MICRO-7C1：At Valley Redoubt Conservation Repository, the atmospheric filtration system installation is confirmed as true with activated carbon and chemical chemisorption filtration banks physically installed across vault air recirculation and intake headers, and the maximum interior relative humidity recorded across archive core storage chambers during 30-day baseline testing is 50 %.
CONS-MICRO-THO：At Highland Subterranean Vault Facility, the atmospheric filtration system installation is confirmed as true with activated carbon and chemical chemisorption filtration banks physically installed across vault air recirculation and intake headers, and the maximum interior relative humidity recorded across archive core storage chambers during 30-day baseline testing is 50 %.
CONS-MICRO-QXK：At Old Quarry Limestone Archive, the atmospheric filtration system installation is confirmed as true with activated carbon and chemical chemisorption filtration banks physically installed across vault air recirculation and intake headers, while the maximum interior relative humidity recorded across archive core storage chambers during 30-day baseline testing reached 60 %.
